wa_narrow_arrow_overhang.notes: Ledgy climbing to a left-facing corner/crack system, then face and corner moves past 2 bolts to a ledge anchor. The grade for this pitch is inconsistently reported (possibly conflated with the easier, related Narrow Arrow line), so it is left unlisted here.

Shallow opposing corners with tricky stemming; small, finicky gear (nuts, offsets, RPs, cams to 1 in). 3 bolts on the upper section including the anchor, a bit runout below a lieback. Crux is a physical sequence over a roof. Route is about 120 ft total, single 70m rappel descent.
